defects.claim_says: The single clause, which includes the naming sentence ('This reservation shall be known as the Pioneer Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge'), ended on 1958-08-05 by Public Land Order 1704. The only later event is Reorganization Plan No. II, and no earlier named instrument was found.
defects.source_says: Proclamation No. 2416, 'Changing the Names of Certain Federal Wildlife Refuges', was signed July 25, 1940, filed July 27, 1940, and printed at 5 FR 2677-2680 (Federal Register of July 30, 1940). Its held FR text layer is jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_8494.txt (sha256 87e6c363552ebc78ddc3b93a269adfe3752ef2d318a06f44831141791d006bb8; also EO_8496.txt). It says: 'do proclaim that the names of the Federal wildlife refuges listed below are hereby changed as indicated'. The old-name column lists 'Pioneer Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge' and the new-name column lists 'Pioneer Lake National Wildlife Refuge'. This held presidential act names the refuge and replaced the order's naming command 18 years before PLO 1704. The claim omits it.

evidence_checked: Diff of the genuine claim against the blind-review control: the only differences are first_end.date and whole_order_end.date, both now 1958-08-05
Re-hashed every cited text file and checked every quoted span against the bytes: all match; local PDFs re-hashed
jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_8163.txt (4 FR 2409): the whole order read; signed June 12, 1939
PLO 1704 text and PDF: signed by Roger Ernst, Assistant Secretary of the Interior, on August 5, 1958; filed Aug. 8, 1958; revokes EO 8163 (Pioneer Lake, Sec. 21, 640 acres)
cruden number search EO:8163: the only hit is PLO 1704
grep of held texts for 'Pioneer Lake': found Proclamation 2416 (5 FR 2677)
reasoning: The corrected dates now match PLO 1704, which was signed August 5, 1958. They also agree with the claim's own narrative. Identity, quotes, actor, mechanism, the catalog-date note and the treatment of Reorganization Plan No. II all check out, and the whole-order end of 1958-08-05 is probably right. The claim still has the defect found in the blind review, which also applies to EO 8129. Its single clause expressly includes the naming sentence, yet the claim says that clause, name included, ended in 1958 and that no earlier named instrument exists. The repository holds Proclamation 2416 of July 25, 1940, which renamed the 'Pioneer Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge' as the 'Pioneer Lake National Wildlife Refuge'. The claim can be fixed in either of two ways. It can record the proclamation as a later event (actor PROC:2416, effective 1940-07-25, a renaming that replaced the naming sentence, source 5 FR 2677). Or it can split the naming sentence into its own clause with a 1940 first end. In both cases it must correct the statement that the name ended in 1958 and the statement that no earlier named instrument exists. The searches by order number alone were not enough for this order. Rejected.
